title: ticfac-run-state.json's attempt wording reads per-tick while the code treats numbers as run-wide identity
body: The contract says attempts/<n>.json carries "the 1-based attempt number for the tick", but internal/reconcile's nextAttemptNumber makes numbers run-wide identity (they name the branch, the marker and `ticfac settle`), and the live run's attempts/1.json is the run's first dispatch (tick l9n's first try). The phrase misled a first implementation into per-tick numbering until the Go source was read. The fix is wording in the ticks-owned bundle, not code.
